remarks: A fresh take on modern living, where thoughtful design, effortless style, and a little extra breathing room come together. Welcome to 1120 W Fiat Street, an intimate collection of just four thoughtfully designed, fully detached residences bringing a sophisticated new perspective to Torrance living. Set behind a gated entrance, each home offers the privacy of a single-family residence with the ease of contemporary, low-maintenance living. Spanning approximately 2,870 square feet across two beautifully designed levels, this four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bath residence is all about clean lines, warm textures, and spaces that feel as good as they look.
